cards.title: Frost Hollow foes
cards.text: Hunter and momma spiders and the banshee redrawn; the frost wolf with your wolf fixes.
cards.why: The spiders and banshee are still round 4-5 drawings you turned down. Spiders now use the ticked fire spider's build, the banshee the ghosts'. The frost wolf gets the wolves' fix. Left: the game now. Right: the option, 3x and game size.

items.label: Hunter Spider A: Chevron
items.text: The old hunter's colours and chevron, in the fire spider's build.

items.label: Hunter Spider B: Striped
items.text: A wolf spider: one dark stripe, banded knees, a bigger head and fangs.

items.label: Momma Spider A: Clutch
items.text: Huge abdomen, one tidy clutch of seven same-size eggs on her back.

items.label: Momma Spider B: Egg sac
items.text: Carries a white silk egg sac on her back: where her brood comes from.

items.label: Banshee A: Wailer
items.text: In the ghosts' build: their eyes, a wailing mouth, long hair streaming back.

items.label: Banshee B: Hollow
items.text: The Hollow's skull you said to keep for a banshee, in a ragged shroud.

items.label: Banshee C: Veil
items.text: A under a teal veil that trails behind her.

items.label: Frost Wolf A: No paws
items.text: Your wolf fixes: head forward, body shorter, no paws (as the picked wolves).

items.label: Frost Wolf B: Paws under
items.text: The same, with the front paws drawn under the body.

cards.title: Ember Deep foes
cards.text: Imp, devil, demon and succubus redrawn beside the Pit Lord; the hellhound with your wolf fixes.
cards.why: Imp, devil and demon are round-5 stand-ins (your ticked round-6 fixes never reached the game: the middle picture). The succubus is the devil turned pink. All in the Pit Lord's build, each its own outline.

items.label: Imp A: Firebrand
items.text: Nearly all head, little horns, long ears, a grin, a fireball in hand.

items.label: Imp B: Match head
items.text: A flame burning on its head instead of horns, darker red.

items.label: Devil A: Trident
items.text: Crimson, widow's peak, goatee, horns, bat wings, gold trident.

items.label: Devil B: High collar
items.text: No wings: a black cloak with a tall collar behind the head.

items.label: Demon A: Ram
items.text: Plum brute, glowing cracks, curled ram horns, a glowing mouth, huge fists.

items.label: Demon B: Bull
items.text: A bull of the pit: wide pale horns, a gold nose ring, huge fists.

items.label: Succubus A: Wings
items.text: Her own sprite: plum hair, small horns, rose wings, a heart-tipped tail.

items.label: Succubus B: Whip
items.text: Hair in a high tail, wings folded small, a coiled whip.

items.label: Hellhound A: No paws
items.text: Your wolf fixes: head forward, body shorter, no paws (as the picked wolves).

items.label: Hellhound B: Paws under
items.text: The same, with the front paws drawn under the body.
